results.name: a fresh Docker volume belongs to root and nobody else may write it
started as node on that volume, the server refuses to boot and says the saved positions could not be opened

results.name: started as root on that volume, the server boots with its positions on disk
the server is PID 1 and runs as node: uid, gid and groups are all node, none is root

results.name: no process running in the container is root
the volume, the file the earlier root deploy left and the write-ahead log now belong to node
nothing else was handed over: a link in the volume was not followed (/etc/passwd and the link still belong to root), nor was another directory in it or the file inside
Docker's own health check passes through the entrypoint
a browser on the served page is seated and its player walks east
docker stop reaches the server: it says it is stopping, exits 0, and well inside the 10 seconds Docker allows
a new container on the same volume finds one saved player on disk in /data
the same browser opens the new container and its player stands where they were
the replacement also runs its server as node
